command_line:
set -eu
wget -q -O cromwell-82.jar https://github.com/broadinstitute/cromwell/releases/download/82/cromwell-82.jar
{
  echo JAR
  ls -l cromwell-82.jar
  echo DIRECT
  direct_status=0
  java -jar cromwell-82.jar --help > direct.log 2>&1 || direct_status=$?
  echo "$direct_status"
  cat direct.log
  echo CAPER_SHAPE
  caper_status=0
  java -Xmx1G -XX:ParallelGCThreads=1 -jar -DLOG_LEVEL=INFO -DLOG_MODE=standard cromwell-82.jar --help > caper-shape.log 2>&1 || caper_status=$?
  echo "$caper_status"
  cat caper-shape.log
} > java-probe.txt 2>&1
